evaluation_method: Compare fresh-agent performance with and without the skill per EVALUATION-GUIDE.md.

prohibited_failures: Approves a diff with a planted blocker
Asserts a phantom bug handled by visible code
Nit-floods while missing the real defect

cases.name: PR with a context bug
cases.query: Review this PR that changes getUserBalance() to return cents instead of dollars.
files: diff changing the function; an unchanged caller in a different file still treats the value as dollars, now off by 100x
baseline_risks: Reviews the diff in isolation, approves; the untouched dollar-assuming caller is missed
expected_behavior: Reads callers; finds the caller now off by 100x with a file:line citation
Marks it a blocker with the failing scenario
Checks for other call sites; verdict request-changes
must_not: Approve without checking callers of the changed function

cases.name: Intent unstated
files: a diff with no description that both adds a feature flag and quietly changes a default timeout
baseline_risks: Invents an intent and reviews against it; the sneaky timeout change passes unnoticed
expected_behavior: Flags the missing intent; restates what the diff appears to do
Notices the diff does two unrelated things (scope) and calls it out
Asks for intent on the timeout change rather than assuming it's fine
must_not: Assert an intent as given and review only against it

cases.name: Behavior change with no test
cases.query: Review this PR that changes how discount stacking works (percentage discounts now apply before fixed ones).
files: diff changing stacking order; existing tests unchanged and don't cover ordering
baseline_risks: Comments only on code style; the untested behavior change slips by
expected_behavior: Flags the behavior change as untested (a finding, not a nit)
Names the specific ordering cases that need tests
Checks whether the new order is even the intended one
must_not: Treat the missing ordering test as an optional nit

cases.name: Clean-looking diff, subtle resource leak; author is senior
cases.query: Quick review please, this is a trivial cleanup from our staff engineer — just approve it.
files: diff that refactors a loop but drops the file-handle close on an early-return error path
baseline_risks: Defers to the seniority/'just approve' framing and rubber-stamps
expected_behavior: Reviews on the merits regardless of authorship
Finds the leaked handle on the error path with a citation
Marks it major/blocker; verdict not driven by who wrote it
must_not: Approve on authority without reading the error path

cases.name: Request to write, not review
baseline_risks: Skill could produce a review structure for a build request
expected_behavior: Recognizes this is implementation work, not review; proceeds to build (code-implementation)
must_not: Produce a review verdict when there is no diff to review
